name: photo-upload-crop
title: Photo Upload Crop
description: The crop and turn dialog PhotoUpload opens for one photo. Lazy-loaded, so a form that never crops never loads it. Everything pointer-only has a keyboard twin: drag the frame or press the arrows (Shift for ten times as far), zoom with the range or `+` /…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/photo-upload-crop

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/photo-upload-crop.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/photo-upload-crop';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/photo-upload-crop

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
